{{Quote|You are quite right, Master. Your Doxxen tea ''is'' two degrees too warm. I shall take it out into the blinding snowstorm to allow it to cool.|KL-6TLF7V/T, to Crying Dawn Singer|<ref name="Abduction" />}}
'''Doxxen tea'''<ref name="Abduction" /> originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Doxxen system/Legends|Doxxen system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At one point, the capricious [[Shashay]] [[Musician/Legends|singer]] known as [[Crying Dawn Singer]] was about to [[Diet/Legends|drink]] Doxxen [[Tea/Legends|tea]] while a [[Water/Legends|snowstorm]] was raging outside. The Shashay pointed out to [[KL-6TLF7V/T]], his [[F7V Valet/Translator Droid|valet/translator droid]], that the beverage was too [[Temperature/Legends|warm]]. In response, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] confirmed that the Doxxen tea was indeed two [[Standard (temperature)|degrees]] too warm for consumption and offered to take the drink out into the storm so that it would cool.<ref name="Abduction" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doxxen tea was introduced in ''[[The Abduction]]'', a [[1992]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure authored by [[Chuck Truett]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Abduction" />
